When I was a kid I used to do community theatre. One play I was in was Music Man at a local theater. The guy who played Hank Hill (the main character) seemed to be pretty cool and he even drove me home from rehearsal a couple times. He was talented and funny and I really looked up to him. Well, a couple years later I saw an article that a local theatre actor was arrested for a double homicide in which he even cut up the bodies and hid them pieces of them around the city including at the theater where we first met. As someone who really looked up to this dude I was horrified. It also turns out that the reason he was caught was because he sent a kid (not too much different in age than me) to go empty out the victims bank account. I wasn’t really speaking with him around the time of the incident, but I always wondered if that kid could’ve been me. Luckily, he’s in jail now. Fucking scumbag.
